scope: one conservative post-cutover production hosting design; NOT the lowest possible architecture or capacity proof

assumptions.endpointCountBasis: Current Neon private-networking guide lists eight eu-central-1 services and instructs adding all. A project-specific subset is not verified.
separateAwsExecutionUnits: private connector with no application authority
assumptions.executionUnit: ARM .25 vCPU / .5 GiB / one public IPv4, no inbound public application listener
assumptions.secrets: 13 existing functional categories plus 2 new connector/operational records; planning inventory, not a fresh AWS count
assumptions.s3PublicEgress: assumed within unused account-wide 100 GB/month allowance; excess adds actual source-side egress
assumptions.reserveLines: monitoring/journal/drill values are budget allowances, not provider flat-price packages

totalFormula: 168.593925 + Q_region + usage beyond stated assumptions + tax and any existing non-hosting services
notProven: equal protection for this undeployed architecture
actual CPU sizing or monthly demand
transition: Existing AWS continues to bill until an authorized, verified cutover and resource retirement; no present savings claimed.
credits: No Startup credit is awarded or subtracted. Time-limited credits do not define long-term cost.
